findings.evidence: Mathlib/CategoryTheory/Subobject/MonoOver.lean:71-75 uses `def mk`, while `forget`/`arrow`/`homMk` are `abbrev`; the PR turns `mk` into an `abbrev` alone among these.
findings.fix: Make both `mk`s plain `def`s (as `MonoOver.mk` is: `@[simps] def mk {X A : C} (f : A ⟶ X) [hf : Mono f] : MonoOver X`), keeping `mk_coe`/`mk_proj` as the stated interface.
findings.issue: `CoveringSpace.mk` (line 73) and `ConnectedCoveringSpace.mk` (line 173) are `abbrev`, i.e. `@[reducible]`, so `mk p hp` unfolds to the raw `⟨Over.mk p, hp⟩` literal for unification and simp. That exposes the constructor body, and it makes the accompanying simp lemmas `mk_coe` (78, 179) and `mk_proj` (87, 188) degenerate: their LHSs reduce to the bare variables `E` / `p` at reducible transparency, so they are not usable rewrite patterns.

findings.evidence: Mathlib/CategoryTheory/Subobject/MonoOver.lean:136-138: `@[simps!] def mkArrowIso {X : C} (f : MonoOver X) : mk f.arrow ≅ f := isoMk (Iso.refl _)`.
findings.fix: Add `@[simp]` lemmas `(mkProjIso p).hom.hom.left = 𝟙 (p : TopCat)` and `(mkProjIso p).inv.hom.left = 𝟙 (p : TopCat)` in both namespaces (Mathlib marks the analogue `@[simps!]`).
findings.issue: `mkProjIso` (136) and `ConnectedCoveringSpace.mkProjIso` (246) are opaque `def`s with no component lemmas: nothing computes `(mkProjIso p).hom.hom.left`. Unlike `isoMk`, whose `simp` lemmas are stated by hand (126-133, 233-243), `mkProjIso` cannot be unfolded by `simp` since it is not reducible.

findings.evidence: Mathlib/CategoryTheory/Subobject/MonoOver.lean:83-99 states `forget_obj_left`, `mk_coe`, `mk_arrow`, `forget_obj_hom`; the PR states none of the `forget_obj_*` analogues, and nothing at all for the connected inclusion at line 162.
findings.fix: Add `@[simp]` lemmas for the inclusion: `((forget X).obj p : TopCat) = (p : TopCat)`, `((forget X).obj p).proj = p.proj`, `((forget X).map f).hom.left = f.hom.left`, and `(forget X).obj (mk p hp) = CoveringSpace.mk p hp`; then derive `ConnectedCoveringSpace.w` and `isIso_iff_isHomeomorph` from the `CoveringSpace` versions rather than re-proving them. Also add the `CoveringSpace.forget` analogues Mathlib states for `MonoOver` (`((forget X).obj p).left = (p : TopCat)`, `((forget X).obj p).hom = p.proj`).
findings.issue: `ConnectedCoveringSpace.forget : ConnectedCoveringSpace X ⥤ CoveringSpace X` has no characterizing lemmas, so the whole `ConnectedCoveringSpace` namespace (mk/proj/coe/w/isoMk/isIso_iff_isHomeomorph, 169-259) is a shadow copy with no stated connection to its `CoveringSpace` counterparts; a consumer transporting any cover result to a connected cover has to fall back on defeq.

findings.evidence: Mathlib/CategoryTheory/Subobject/MonoOver.lean:55-65: `abbrev Over.isMono (X : C) : ObjectProperty (Over X) := fun f => Mono f.hom` and `abbrev MonoOver (X : C) := (Over.isMono X).FullSubcategory`.
findings.fix: Introduce `TauCeti.Over.isCoveringMap (X : TopCat) : ObjectProperty (Over X) := fun p ↦ IsCoveringMap p.hom` and define `CoveringSpace X := (Over.isCoveringMap X).FullSubcategory` and `ConnectedCoveringSpace X` from `Over.isCoveringMap X ⊓ fun p ↦ ConnectedSpace p.left`, with `forget := ObjectProperty.ιOfLE inf_le_left`.
findings.issue: The selecting property is inlined as an anonymous lambda in both `CoveringSpace` (54-55) and `ConnectedCoveringSpace` (153-155), which re-inlines `IsCoveringMap p.hom` rather than refining a named property. No `ObjectProperty (Over X)` is exposed, so no `ObjectProperty`-level statement (a `≤`, an `inf`, `IsClosedUnderIsomorphisms`) can be made about covers without repeating the lambda, and the `≤` witness at 163 is an ad-hoc `fun _ hp ↦ hp.1`.

summary: The surface mirrors `MonoOver` but deviates in ways that hurt it: `mk` is a reducible `abbrev`, which exposes the constructor body and makes its `mk_coe`/`mk_proj` simp lemmas degenerate; `mkProjIso` carries no component lemmas; and nothing relates the `ConnectedCoveringSpace` API to the `CoveringSpace` API across `forget`.
